title: Assistant Acquisition Manager-Branch Banking
description:
* POSITION DESCRIPTION


 JOB TITLE : Assistant Acquisition Manager
   

  

 GRADE : AM\-II
   

  

 DEPARTMENT : Branch Banking
   

  

 LOCATION : Branch
   

  

 SUB\-DEPARTMENT : TYPE OF POSITION : Full\-time
   

  

 REPORTS TO : Branch Sales Manager \- Branch Banking
   

  

 REPORTING INTO
   

  

 NA
   

  

* ROLE PURPOSE \& OBJECTIVE


 The incumbent will be primarily responsible to \-
   

  

* Acquire new customers for liabilities from open market
* Assist the CRS \- unsecured loans for conversion of existing borrowing customers for liabilities
* Enhance the relationship with the existing customers by cross\-selling products and services as per the profile \& need of the customers
* Train/assist customers to use ATM and BCs; drive usage of alternate channels
* SIZE OF THE ROLE


 FINANCIAL SIZE
   

  

 NON\-FINANCIAL SIZE
   

  

* Target assigned as per the branch
* CASA Book – as per the branch
* TD Book – as per the branch
* Segment wise book (NR, Senior Citizen, HNI etc) – as per the branch
* Number target for all the respective products.
* CA
* SA
* TD
* KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE


**Business**
* Meet the set targets on liabilities in terms of open market acquisition \& existing customer conversion
* Understand need and acquire customers who meet the criteria for liability products through either of the below channels:
* Leads generated by branch staff and personal leads
* Referrals generated from existing customers
* Alternate channels
* Maintain the database of the prospects, meet select prospects and manage the relationship thereafter
* Accompany CRS\-Unsecured loans on the field for actively driving conversion of existing borrowing customers into liabilities customer
* Cross sell other secured loan products of Ujjivan and pass quality leads to respective loan officers
* Share customer insights/product related feedback with the Sales Manager \- Liabilities


**Customers**
* Interact with customers in a courteous and professional manner; provide prompt, efficient and accurate services
* Reduce customer dormancy and customer attrition by continuous engagement / interaction
* Resolves the customer queries on various accounts, FD / RD, remittances \& third party product


**Internal Processes**
* Guide the customer to fill the ‘Account Opening Form’; ensure receipt and verification of KYC documents; obtain customer signatures on all mandatory documents
* Strictly adhere \& maintain compliance to KYC norms
* Drive the usage of alternate channels such as ATMs, BCs and assist customers to use ATMs for dispensing cash


**Learning \& Performance**
* Maintain up to date knowledge of the liabilities products and services as well as a working knowledge of other products offered in the branch
* Resolve queries raised by CRS\-unsecured loans w.r.t liability products and support them in selling liabilities
* Ensure adherence to training man\-days/ mandatory training programs for self


 Ensure goal setting, mid\-year review and performance appraisal processes are completed within specified timelines
   

  

* MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS OF KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS


 Educational
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Graduate, preferably in commerce and related streams


**Experience**
* 1\-3 year experience, preferably in sales


 Certifications
   

  

* AMFI / IRDA Certified


 Functional Skills
   

  

* Basic knowledge on retail banking products
* Documentation skills
* Process compliance focus
* Communication skills: fluent in the local language


 Behavioral Skills
   

  

* Courteous customer service skills
* Time Management
* Selling skills
* Telephonic cold calling skills
* Willingness to travel \& relocation as per business requirements and career opportunities


 Competencies
   

  

* Planning \& Organizing
* Driving Execution
* Managing Relationships
* Customer Focus
* KEY INTERACTIONS


 INTERNAL
   

  

 EXTERNAL
   

  

* Branch Team – Unsecured Loans (CRM, CRS); Secured Loans (Loan Officers); Operations team
* Regional Product \& Marketing team
* State HR
* BC Agents

 DATE: 14\-02\-2024
   

  

 REVIEWED BY: Jyothi Mohan
   

  

 DATE: 15\-02\-2024
   

  

 LAST UPDATED BY: TM Team
   

  

 DATE: 17\-02\-2024

title: Officer-Assets Desk (Gold Loan)
description:
* POSITION DESCRIPTION


 JOB TITLE : Officer\-Assets Desk
   

  

 GRADE : DM\-I
   

  

 DEPARTMENT : Operations
   

  

 LOCATION : Branch
   

  

 SUB\-DEPARTMENT : Gold Loan
   

  

 TYPE OF POSITION : Full\-time
   

  

 REPORTS TO : BOO
   

  

 REPORTING INTO
   

  

 NA
   

  

* ROLE PURPOSE \& OBJECTIVE


* Processing all Gold Loan login cases from branches and supporting Gold Loan customers at branch level
* Will do cross sell other product to Gold Loan customers.
* To facilitate Repayment, Renewal, Closer and Fore closer of Gold Loan along with new loan procession at branch level.
* Responsible to maintain process quality \& ensures adherence to internal audit standards for Gold Loan.
* Will act as back\-up for BOO and CCR at branch and will responsible for their job in their absence (For All branch formats: BB\-led, MB\-Led, URC and SFB).
* SIZE OF THE ROLE


 FINANCIAL SIZE
   

  

 NON\-FINANCIAL SIZE
   

  

 NA
   

  

 NA
   

  

* KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE


**Business/ Financials**
* Responsible for acquisition of Gold Loan customers from both NTB walk\-in and ETB customers at branch level.
* Engagement of Gold Loan customers and responsible for cross sell of other products.
* Support the marketing initiatives designed by products \& marketing department for Gold Loan.
* Assess the market potential/trend and give feedback on product modification and new product development to the product teams
* Share insights on competitor products to the product team.
* Responsible for the overall cross sell target assigned to him for other products.


**Customer**
* Ensure customers and branch team to be educated about the Gold Loan product offered.
* Marketing \& branding of Gold Loan to be done at branch level
* Resolve customer queries/grievances at branch level (pertaining to Gold Loan)


**Internal Process**
* Oversee and facilitate collection of documents for Gold Loan processing.
* Ensure the proper handling of Gold ornaments as per policy standards.
* Responsible to ensure the storage of Gold ornaments in safe vault after loan processing.
* Handle the relationship with Gold Appraisers at branch level for loan processing.
* Responsible to facilitate the Vigilance team at time of sample check.
* Follow\-up for the Loan renewal of Gold Loan through calling.
* Oversee follow\-ups with overdue and renewal customers to collect the payments/renewal payment in Gold Loan.
* In absence of CCR, will process all the Service Request and resolve the quires of all customers at branch level.
* In absence of BOO, will act its back\-up for all operational activity.
* Responsible to maintain good coordination with Gold Loan Officer for processing the all leads of Gold Loan with in suggested TAT.
* Should be compatible with Financial Software application Like LOS, Br.net, Finacle etc.
* Ensure smooth operations for Gold Loan and Busimoni at branch at cashier and BOO level.
* Monitoring the leads status, and ensuring timely closer.
* Ensure all operational work of channel partners to be done smoothly at branch.


**Learning \& Innovation**
* Coach the branch staff on Gold loans products and support generating leads for that from existing customers.
* Resolve queries and escalations from the branch team related to Gold Loan in a well\-defined timeframe.
* Ensure adherence to training man\-days/ mandatory training programs for self.
* Ensure goal\-setting, midyear \-review and annual appraisal process happens within specified timelines for self.
* MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS OF KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS


 Educational
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Graduate in Commerce/Business/Economics or related subjects with good analytical and sales skills to be considered.


**Experience**
* 1\-2 years of experience in Gold Loan Industry or within Ujjivan


 Certifications
   

  

* NA


 Functional Skills
   

  

* Knowledge on Gold Loan and OD products
* Basic Computer knowledge (MS Office, Outlook) / Ease of technology usage
* Basic knowledge of accounting and finance administration desirable
* Is fluent in the local languages and has a working knowledge of English
* Knowledge of KYC/AML norms and other guidelines


 Behavioral Skills
   

  

* Cross selling skills
* Willingness to travel \& relocation as per business requirements and career opportunities
* Interpersonal skills
* Ability to interface (orally and in writing) with all levels of associates and customers
* Ability to manage channel partners and other stakeholders
* Training skills


 Competencies Required
   

  

* Building Relationship
* Driving Change
* Facilitate Marketing and branding
* Collaboration
* KEY INTERACTIONS


 INTERNAL
   

  

 EXTERNAL
   

  

* Gold Loan Business Team
* Branch Operations Team
* Gold Loan Product Team
* State HR
* Customers
* Channel Partners

title: Senior Manager Sales
description:
**Company Description** 




 Amity University is India’s leading non\-profit private university, known for its commitment to academic excellence and a global culture in education. With campuses across India and globally in cities like Dubai, London, Singapore, and New York, the university offers career\-focused undergraduate and postgraduate programs across diverse disciplines. Amity is recognized with the highest 'A\+' Grade Accreditation by NAAC and is consistently ranked as the Number 1 Non\-Profit Private University. The institution prides itself on cultivating leaders who are industry\-ready professionals with strong values and a commitment to making a positive impact. With top\-tier faculty and state\-of\-the\-art campuses, Amity fosters a learning community dedicated to innovation, research, and academic rigor.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Raurkela for the role of Center Manager at Amity University. The Center Manager will oversee the daily operations of the center, ensure its smooth functioning, and maintain academic and administrative excellence. Responsibilities include managing a team of staff and faculty, handling student services, ensuring compliance with institutional policies, and achieving academic and operational goals. The role will also entail effective coordination between various departments and stakeholders, keeping up with the university's standards of quality and values.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 ·        Taking care of all the marketing related activities.
 



 ·        Generating Admissions.
 



 ·        Visiting Schools and Colleges for Presentations
 



 ·        Tie ups with Consultants for International Admissions
 



 ·        Conducting Seminars
 



 ·        Counseling Students and Parents
 



 ·        Handling day to day activities of the center
 



 ·        Travelling in and around the region
 



 Motivating the Team 
 



  





 7\-10 yrs experience
 



 Salary\- 45\-55K
 



 10\-15 Years experience
 



 Salary\- 55\- 65K

title: Sales Service Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced and target\-oriented candidate to join
 **Service Sales department** 
 to drive service business growth and develop long\-term customer relationships. The role will be responsible for generating revenue through
 **UPS Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC), batteries, and spare parts** 
 , while identifying new business opportunities and maximizing existing customer potential.
 **Candidate from UPS industry will be preferred.** 




  





**Designation** 
 : Manager – Service Sales
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Generate service sales revenue for:** 




  




1. Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
2. Batteries
3. Spare Parts



  




* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and new customers.
* Identify AMC renewal opportunities and ensure timely closure.
* Coordinate with service and technical teams for customer support and issue resolution.
* Prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and close service orders.
* Achieve monthly and annual sales targets.
* Maintain customer database and service sales records.
* Conduct regular customer visits and follow\-ups.
* Work closely with regional sales and service teams to expand service business.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Good knowledge of UPS systems, batteries, and power backup solutions.
* Experience in service sales of AMC, batteries, and spare parts.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and reporting tools.



 Educational Qualification: Diploma / B.Tech / BE in Electrical, Electronics, or related field.
 



 Location: Manesar
 



 Industry Preference: UPS industry
